minimal_package.assets: No games, personal data, bitmap font pack, network or package installer.
minimal_package.native_escape: Preserve firmware Home pad and its confirmation.

hardware_model.note: Family/model only; strip unique suffixes and IDs.

gc_count_raw.note: Record raw numeric counter only; do not assume unit or native-image inclusion.

gc_count_unit.note: Use unknown unless the exact API contract establishes units.

capture.privacy: Reject fields outside allowlists; no device IDs, MAC/serial, credentials, paths/book titles, save contents, firmware images, arbitrary ctx/log dumps or raw errors.

marker.write_trigger: Explicit operator Save only; callback counters remain in memory until Save. No automatic on_load/on_leave storage write.
marker.read_failure: Missing marker is a new sandbox; malformed/read failure is visible and cannot be silently replaced. Disable Save until disposition.
marker.write_failure: Preserve last readable marker when possible; display fixed error code, disable further Save and stop. Post-write readback mismatch remains FAILED, never silently retried or cleared.
marker.retention: Overwrite one bounded marker with readback; do not create per-event files. No private payload. Persisted leave_count is UNKNOWN unless actually captured.
